key_insight: AI can help untangle and predict the complex instability of 3D all-inorganic CsPbX3 perovskites by linking diagnosis, mechanism discovery, reliability forecasting, and mitigation strategies.
engineering_relevance: The review frames AI as a practical tool for designing more stable perovskite materials and devices for photovoltaics, photodetectors, and LEDs.
evidence_signal: The abstract emphasizes that current studies are limited by multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification, motivating AI-based analysis.
watch_item: Model transferability and benchmark consistency remain major concerns because data quality, evaluation protocols, and interpretability are still uneven across studies.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
